goal_context.current_plan: Continue the coordinator graph through diagnosis, repair, independent review, build, live validation and publication while keeping all open actor, comparison and raid requirements visible.

objective: Make non-comparable tank and healer reference conditions explicit through the role harness and phase-8 aggregate contract, while retaining a real numerical floor for comparable records and keeping Blood actor acceptance open.
current_plan: Propagate reference-floor applicability from role evaluation through compact campaign results and aggregate contract summaries. Add executable coverage for incompatible references, comparable passing references, comparable below-floor references, and aggregate hard-floor semantics. Do not change Blood policy or native gameplay.
completed_work: The exact Blood tank window is closed and cleaned. Loaded profile and native candidate evidence do not prove a priority inversion. The first review-approved harness change correctly identifies an incompatible reference, but independent review found that phase-8 aggregate accounting still counts its false hard_floor_passed marker as a hard-floor failure.
known_blockers_and_prior_retries: The previous Blood priority hypothesis was reworked after native evidence disproved it. The role fixture compares six-target tank output with a single-target simulator reference, and the aggregate campaign code has no separate applicability field.
first_broken_edge: role_calibration:phase8 hard-floor aggregation treats an explicitly non-comparable tank/healer reference as a failed numerical floor.
proposed_change: Keep Blood SQL, native comparator, WoWSims/reference data, encounter behavior and safety policy unchanged. Add a hard_floor_applicable field to compact campaign results, exclude inapplicable references from hard-floor failure and optimization backlog summaries, and test the boundary.
forbidden_changes: Do not change WoWSims or reference catalog data.
Do not change the Blood SQL migration, native candidate comparator, spell coefficients, gear, stats, encounter behavior, route, target geometry or safety policy.
Do not make an incompatible tank/healer reference pass actor or raid performance acceptance.
Do not remove Heart Strike fallback or multi-target Blood Boil behavior.
Do not close actor_30002 or any other open parent requirement from this contract change.
acceptance_conditions: An incompatible tank/healer record reports reference_conditions_not_comparable and does not report reference_hard_floor as its cause.
An incompatible record remains non-passing for role qualification but is not counted as a numerical hard-floor failure or optimization backlog entry.
A comparable record still applies the configured floor and a below-floor comparable record fails it.
Threat aura, healer exposure, damage smoothing, defensive coverage and all other tank-specific checks remain enforced.
Independent review, gate-bearing build and one exact cleaned role run remain required; actor and raid acceptance remain separate.
observations: The prior focused and phase-7 tests passed, but the first independent review identified an aggregate-contract gap.
Feynman independently classified the 0.552 Blood result as a non-comparable calibration mismatch rather than a proven Blood priority edge.
The current source change is Python-only and must not trigger a Blood SQL/native policy edit.
The graph rework retained all parent requirements and actor_30002 remains open.
acceptance_claim: No actor, performance or raid acceptance is claimed; this plan only repairs diagnostic classification and aggregate accounting.
